surfaces.surface_label: DIUx Austin roll-out at Capital Factory as reported, 14 September 2016
bounded_by: Office of the Texas Governor release of the same day, held on the official counterpart surface
surfaces.notes: Breaking Defense reports DIU(X) Austin will occupy space within Capital Factory, be led by Christine (Christy) Abizaid and staffed largely by Guard and Reserve members reporting to Navy Reserve Commander Doug Beck, and captions a photo of "Capital Factory executive director Joshua Baer" talking with Carter at the roll-out. Built In Austin quotes Baer as Capital Factory founder and names First Lieutenant Samantha Snabes as the first reservist. Defense News reports $65 million in DIUx contracts in the pipeline (a pipeline figure, not obligations). Official counterpart: the Office of the Texas Governor’s release of 14 September 2016 says Secretary of Defense Ash Carter and UT System Chancellor William McRaven announced the opening of the DIUx Austin outpost at the Capital Factory that day. That release is the basis of the hop-eligible surface diux-austin-outpost-at-capital-factory-2016-09-14, an observation of the same event, which carries official rows for Carter, McRaven and Governor Greg Abbott. The rows here stay press-reported and are not duplicated as official rows; the release names none of Joshua Baer, Christine Abizaid, Doug Beck or Samantha Snabes, so no official record yet covers them.
